opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music in any genre, enabling the UK's most talented music creators to realise their potential and reach audiences.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers, supporting activities including recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, as well as future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region
opportunities.summary: A targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London, providing financial support and regional industry infrastructure.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Tees Valley, as well as future industry professionals based in Tees Valley
opportunities.summary: A targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London, providing financial support and regional industry infrastructure.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas
opportunities.summary: Gives composers with a strong track record direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career, supporting up to 15 composers per year for recordings, promotion and performance of works, international co-commissions, residencies, sabbaticals and more.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5,000-£10,000 for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Emerging/early career independent promoters across England
opportunities.summary: Recognises the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, offering grant funding up to £3,500 and capacity building support for booking, programming and promotion of gigs, concerts, club nights, showcases, tours and other performances.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music

deadlines.raw: TBC (bumper deadline in second half of 2026)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who are writing their own music, at different stages of their career
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds. There will be one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026 while the programme is being developed.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators who have been formally invited to perform or participate in an international industry-facing event or songwriting camp.
